item.title: New flag is raised atop the Santa Cruz Town Clock
item.description: “This is not about Republican or Democrat, libertarian or vegetarian,” Mayor Fred Keeley said. “It’s about our country. People who have strong feelings about the direction of the country, positive or negative, they care about their country. And as far as I’m concerned, we are a city that is very proud to be part of our country, with all its positives and negatives.”

item.title: Scientific studies calculate climate change as health danger, while Trump calls it a ‘scam’
item.description: Again and again, research has found increasing disease and deaths in a warming world.

item.title: Guest Commentary | Santa Cruz Sunrise Rotary works to bring community together
item.description: "Beyond fundraising, 2025 was marked by hands-on service and rapid response," writes the Santa Cruz Sunrise Rotary Board of Directors in a Guest Commentary. "When food insecurity surged, our club made a sizable direct financial donation to Second Harvest Food Bank, responding quickly to an urgent community need."

item.title: House renames press gallery after Frederick Douglass in bipartisan recognition of Black history

item.title: Deivon Smith provides spark off bench in Santa Cruz Warriors’ win | NBA G League
item.description: Newly acquired guard Deivon Smith was impressive in his Santa Cruz debut two days ago, and even better in his second game to help the Warriors snap a three-game skid.
